body.statement: If \(G\subseteq H\), then \(\mathcal I_E(H)\subseteq\mathcal I_E(G)\); hence \(G\subseteq K\subseteq H\) and \(G\equiv_E H\) imply \(K\equiv_E G\).
body.justification: This interval property converts transfer into union closure.
body.gap: The check must include ancestry enlargement and SCC merging.
body.consumer: Saturation and deletion tests avoid intermediate retesting.
